answer: An agent economy can limit Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to complete a randomly assigned audit backed by a refundable bond. An auditor checks a signed delivery receipt at the anchor site, compares its timestamp with an independent vertex log, and verifies the voyage record against a separate source. Fabricated or duplicated evidence forfeits the bond, so creating many fake identities multiplies both the capital at risk and the cost of producing distinct, verifiable records.
